labs.summary: Give an agent a long-term memory of its user: a custom AIContextProvider adds the memories stored in MongoDB to each run, as a message framed as data (not as instructions), and extracts the new facts from the user message after it, with another agent and structured output. The memories follow the user from one session to another. Needs the lab's MongoDB container (docker compose up -d); scenario 2 is a chat that waits for your messages.
objectives: Write a custom AIContextProvider: ProvideAIContextAsync before the model call, StoreAIContextAsync after a successful run
Return additional context for a run with AIContext: a message framed as data, kept out of the chat history

Keep the per-session state of the provider (the user id) in the session with ProviderSessionState<T> and a state initializer
Extract facts from the user message with another agent and structured output (RunAsync<T>)
Store the memories per user in MongoDB and find them again in a new session, and when the agent speaks first (RunAsync(session))
